items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: the first drummer I ever seen, a solo drummer, was a drummer by the name of A.G. Godley. Buddy Rich loved him, Jo Jones loved him, all the drummers knew about A.G. Godley.

ctx.x: Was Trent out of Oklahoma City?

No, Alphonso Trent was actually, they were really ahead of their time. They were from, he’s from Arkansas, but he was rich, he was from this family that had plenty money and they had all kinds of uniforms, they were sharp looking cats, and they’d go in those white hotels and stay a year. They went in the Adolphus Hotel, where there were no blacks in © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -15-

those hotels, then they’d go to San Antonio, to the Gunter, and they appeared at all those hotels and things like that. So that’s why I always wanted to be with Trent, you know because of this, they had a good reputation and they never got stranded like bands were getting stranded there in those days, in big cars and all like that.
